name: Wisely Gobal Solutions Pte Ltd
india_angle: WGS has established a support office in Chennai, India, and is the authorized representative of Levitronix in India.
summary: Wisely Gobal Solutions Pte Ltd specializes in ultrapure fluid handling systems, providing advanced equipment like magnetically levitated pumps and ultrasonic flow sensors for precise and contamination-sensitive fluid handling in semiconductor manufacturing. They support microelectronics applications with a focus on achieving high cleanliness and flow stability.
